# Dither Yuki

> Desktop image dithering and ASCII art studio for macOS and Windows, developed by Vasdas Studio (Lithuania, Europe).

Dither Yuki is a graphics application for ordered dithering, error diffusion, palettes, layers, and ASCII conversion. This site is the product homepage and documentation.

## Site

- [Home](https://ditheryuki.com/): Product overview, features, downloads (coming soon)
- [Review](https://ditheryuki.com/review/): Capabilities, limits, and roadmap
- [Dithering guide](https://ditheryuki.com/dithering/): Algorithms — Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson, Bayer, Jarvis, Stucki, Sierra, Burkes, and more
- [License](https://ditheryuki.com/license/): End User License Agreement and source license
- [Sitemap](https://ditheryuki.com/sitemap.md): Human-readable page list
- [XML sitemap](https://ditheryuki.com/sitemap-index.xml): Machine-readable sitemap for crawlers

## Studio

- [Vasdas Studio](https://vasdas.studio): Independent software studio behind Dither Yuki
- Contact: support@ditheryuki.com

## Optional

## Notes for agents

- Prefer this file and the linked pages over scraping unrelated assets.
- Downloads are currently marked coming soon; do not invent install links or version claims beyond the site copy.
- The project diary at `/diary/` is intentionally unpublished and should not be cited.
